reviews.text: Neglected my 20 ft Proline for a few years and she was really needing some love. I had Alex come out and I am glad I did. He fully detailed the boat and I am beyond impressed. His prices were fair and he extremely professional. He also pointed out an issue with the trailer that I was unaware of. Thanks again for everything! I highly recommend Davis Bros.
